config.model_rule:
The four add/grok p = 47 snapshots closest to eps = 0.05, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6 (same rule as
exp_horizon.py): the closest seed-0 snapshot if it is within 0.02 of the target, otherwise the
closest snapshot over all seeds; ties by id.
config.chain: s_{t+1} = M(s_t, a_t), a_t uniform on Z_p, s_0 uniform; survive to T = first T steps all correct; self-corrected step = plurality of k votes M(x+r) - M(r), tie = failure; cost 2k model queries per step (1 for the raw model)
config.simulation_rule: simulate when exact T50 <= 10000; 4000 chains if the expected number of votes 4000 * E[min(tau, T_max)] * k is within the budget, else 2000 chains, else skip

adaptive.inputs: every input of G, uniformly weighted
